title: Specify optional Git task sync with agent-merged text and main-checkout export
outcome: Update the specification for Greg's selected text-based Git synchronization model and obtain Architect1 and Architect2 architectural review.
acceptance: Specification describes local change collection, imported-commit progress, text task layout, initial 1000-task push and incremental push/pull with agent conflict resolution.
Specification defines shared local SQLite with main-checkout-only task export/import and linked-worktree exclusion, with no global writer lock or background network requirement.
Both Engram architects review the concrete candidate and their findings are incorporated or explicitly recorded; prior sequential-handoff material is clearly superseded for this selected workflow.

completion.summary: Specified optional agent-merged Git task synchronization with per-host shared SQLite, main-checkout-only text exchange, incremental progress and lifecycle admission, explicit disclosure rules, no global writer ownership, and supersession of sequential handoff. Incorporated architect-reviewed design and approved corrections; seven Markdown files landed after exact-tree doc gates, clean Codex/Claude round2 and fresh independent acceptance3/3.
